Announcement Under Regulation 30 - Letters Sent To Shareholders

analysis.summary: The provided document for Narmada Gelatine consists largely of unparseable or corrupted character sequences, making it impossible to extract meaningful operational, financial, or strategic commentary from management. Consequently, all specific theme categories and management commitments contain no verifiable factual statements or valid quotes from the text. For FY 2023-24, Narmada Gelatines Limited reported revenue from operations of Rs 181.79 crores and profit after tax of Rs 15.33 crores. EBITDA reached Rs 22.87 crores, reflecting a 3.78% growth over the previous year despite a 4.89% drop in operational revenue. The Board recommended a dividend of Rs 10.00 per Equity Share of Rs 10 each.

demand_outlook.claim: Gelatin is seeing growing demand in nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors due to increasing consumer awareness of its health benefits.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumers are becoming more aware of the health benefits of gelatin usage.

demand_outlook.claim: Gelatine is utilized across multiple sectors including pharmaceuticals, food and beverages, and personal care.
demand_outlook.quote: Gelatine has multiple applications across various industries including food & beverage, pharmaceutical, photography, biomedical, personal care, and other technical areas.

demand_outlook.claim: India's drugs and pharmaceuticals exports grew by 9-10 per cent year-on-year in FY 2023-24.
demand_outlook.quote: The country's drugs and pharmaceuticals exports increased 9-10 per cent year-on-year in 2023-24.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for medicines is expected to rise due to global population ageing trends.
demand_outlook.quote: Owing to the rapid growth of the ageing population across the world, the demand for medicines is expected to increase.

capex_expansion.claim: The company replaced old motors with energy-efficient models and installed temperature controllers to lower steam consumption in gelatin production.
capex_expansion.quote: Replacement of old inefficient motor with new energy efficient motors and installation of temperature controllers to reduce the steam consumption in gelatin production.

capex_expansion.claim: The company installed steam flow meters with various equipment to monitor steam efficiency and prevent leakage.
capex_expansion.quote: Steam Flow meters have been installed with various equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in discussions regarding setting up a 2 MW solar power plant within its factory premises.
capex_expansion.quote: Discussion is on for putting up 2 MW solar power plant with in the factory premises.

margins_costs.claim: Material consumed decreased by 1% due to better yield, while power and fuel costs dropped by 1.5% due to improved boiler efficiency and lower coal prices.
margins_costs.quote: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1%, which is due to better yield, power and fuel cost reduce by 1.5% due to improvement in boiler's efficiency, which resulted in lower consumption of coal and also due to decrease in the coal prices.

margins_costs.claim: Average selling price for gelatine rose by 3.28%, whereas the selling price for DCP declined by 5%.
margins_costs.quote: Average selling price of gelatine increased by 3.28% but DCP decreased by 5% as compared to last year.

margins_costs.claim: Employee costs accounted for 8.21% of revenue from operations in FY 2023-24 compared to 7.17% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Employee cost stood at 8.21% (7.17% previous year) of revenue from operations.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased to 6.35% of revenue from operations compared to 6.23% in the prior year.
margins_costs.quote: Other expenses were on the higher side at 6.35% as compared to the previous year at 6.23% of revenue from operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes of gelatine and DCP decreased by 5% and 8% respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume of gelatine / DCP decreased by 5%/ 8%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Plant-based gelatin substitutes represent a major market obstacle to traditional animal-based gelatin.
risks_headwinds.quote: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes, fueled by rising demand for vegetarian and vegan goods, is one of the primary market barriers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing good quality crushed bones, the primary raw material, presents a significant challenge.
risks_headwinds.quote: The availability of our main raw material, i.e. crushed bones, is a cause of concern The difficulty in sourcing good quality raw material is a major issue.

risks_headwinds.claim: Low-cost industrial grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China and blended into capsule manufacturing.
risks_headwinds.quote: According to the minutes of the meeting of the Drugs Consultative Committee – there is an increasing evidence that low cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China, by unscrupulous traders and sold to capsule manufacturers who blend it with high quality gelatin made in India, in the manufacturing of capsules.

management_commitments.claim: The company is in discussion for installing a 2 MW solar power plant inside the factory premises.
management_commitments.quote: Discussion is on for putting up 2 MW solar power plant with in the factory premises.
